_comment: Default voice config: ElevenLabs /stream TTS (env ELEVENLABS_API_KEY) + Deepgram nova-3 STT via OpenRouter (env OPENROUTER_API_KEY). OpenRouter exposes /audio/transcriptions as batch HTTP only — there is no streaming transcription; for true streaming STT use providers/deepgram-streaming.json with a direct DEEPGRAM_API_KEY. voice_route.mode=server-cascade tells callers the holder terminates audio over a live session.
